description:
Open perp positions for a wallet. venue=None aggregates across venues.

Each position carries its venue + custody_tier. detail="concise" (default)
trims each position to position_id/market/side/size/unrealized_pnl/venue
(position_id is the ID to chain into close_perp_position); "full" adds
entry_price/current_price/leverage/liquidation_price/custody_tier.
name: perp_positions_all
